name: Palette The Travellers Hotel Bangkok
detail: The MRT is quiet and peaceful, but it's a bit hard to find food. It's about 300 meters away from 7-Eleven. I couldn't use the Wi-Fi both nights. The air conditioning is very cold. The hot water is warm to the point of being hot. Overall, it's worth it.

name: Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Bangkok
detail: I used it when traveling to the Queen Sirikit Convention Center. It is directly connected to BTS Asok / MRT Sukhumvit station. When you get off at the station, there are arrows pointing to the hotel above, which is convenient as you can reach the convention center without getting wet from the rain. The station is also directly connected to Terminal 21, making it easy to find places to eat. The room wasn't large, but it was spacious for a Japanese-style hotel, and it was comfortable with good facilities. The staff are also very friendly. (There are staff members who speak Korean!) I haven't had the chance to use the breakfast, bar, or pool.

name: Palette Hi Hotel Bangkok
detail: Room with a good location Review of a room that is beautiful, clean, and offers great value. There are various types and sizes of rooms to choose from, ranging from standard rooms to executive suites, which are very spacious, perfect for relaxing whether you're here for work, a getaway with a partner, family, or hanging out with friends. It's very convenient for traveling, close to shopping malls, the sky train, fresh markets, and night markets. Importantly, the staff here are friendly, polite, and provide excellent service. Highly recommended! Hi Hotel Bangkok ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐🥰🥰

name: Lub d Bangkok Siam – New Look, Across from MBK & Skytrain Access
detail: The accommodation for a week in Bangkok, Thailand, is very cost-effective, with a 24-hour front desk and friendly staff. The beds in the rooms are comfortable and clean, and the common areas are tidy. It's just a few minutes' walk to Siam Discovery, Siam Paragon, and other large shopping malls, and it's also very close to the Erawan Shrine.

name: Nysa Bangkok Sukhumvit 11 by Kingston Hotels
detail: The room is spacious and clean, but unfortunately, it doesn't have smart TV functionality. The breakfast is abundant, with above-average food quality, and the pool and gym look nice. The only drawback is the location. It takes 10 minutes to walk to Nana station, and the road is not very pleasant, with many bars along the way. The shuttle bus frequency is not very high.

name: The Quart Ruamrudee by UHG
detail: I recommend it for the price. First of all, the hotel is very clean and the staff are friendly. The pool is small but decent to use, and breakfast has everything you need. The location is a bit ambiguous, but there is a shuttle service, so it's not particularly inconvenient.

name: Grand Mercure Bangkok Atrium
detail: The cost-performance ratio is particularly high, the view from the room is very good with large windows, and the room is very quiet at night. The mattress is super soft; I really don't want to get up. There is a small river behind the hotel where it seems you can take a boat. There is also a currency exchange machine next to the hotel, and a 7-Eleven on the right side when you go out, which is very convenient. The hotel staff is especially enthusiastic and the service is very attentive. Next time I come to Bangkok, I will stay here again.

name: The Quarter Ladprao by UHG
detail: I am very impressed. This is my first time here, and I would give it a million stars. The location is excellent, close to the MRT, with a 7-Eleven under the hotel. I love it the most. The service is very good from everyone. I asked for extra towels when going to swim, and they brought them to my room immediately. I couldn't increase the TV volume, and they quickly sent someone to fix it. The room is very clean, new, and fully equipped. The bed is big and comfortable, with a sofa too. There are a lot of pillows, which I really like. The bathroom is spacious and clean, with good water pressure and cold air conditioning. The breakfast is abundant and delicious. I'm really impressed, so I booked to continue using the service for my next trip next week because this place is the best right now.

name: Pullman Bangkok Hotel G
detail: I stayed at Pullman Bangkok Hotel G for three nights, from September 8 to 11, 2026, and I truly enjoyed every moment of my stay. The service was excellent from beginning to end, starting with the warm welcome from the Front Office team to the lovely staff at TIVA, the breakfast restaurant. Everyone was friendly, attentive, and provided exceptional service. The room was spacious and very comfortable, with wonderfully cool air conditioning throughout the day. I slept extremely well every night. The atmosphere was so peaceful and relaxing that it was hard to believe the hotel is located right in the middle of such a vibrant city. The location is also very convenient, with easy access to many places around Bangkok. I had a wonderful three-night stay and would definitely recommend Pullman Bangkok Hotel G to anyone looking for a comfortable, peaceful, and well-located hotel with excellent service.

name: Night Hotel Bangkok - Asoke Sukhumvit 15
detail: - Good points It was great to be close to Terminal 21, BTS Asoke Station, and MRT Sukhumvit Station, making it easy to walk around. I didn't use the tuk-tuk service, but I didn't feel inconvenienced at all. Breakfast was delicious, and the menu changed every day, so I could enjoy it without getting bored. All the staff were kind, which made for a comfortable stay. It may be a minor detail, but the hallway had a nice scent that made me feel good every time I entered or exited my room. - Bad points I stayed in the Gold King room. The room itself was spacious, but I was concerned about the soundproofing as I could clearly hear a child's voice from the neighboring room, possibly because it connected through a locked door. The sink's plug did not fully open, leading to poor drainage. I used the gym, but some parts of the machines were quite rusty, which was disappointing even though they were still usable.
